name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Image Gallery
description: Adds an Image Gallery block content type whose referenced image media render as a responsive grid with a GLightbox lightbox viewer.
project_description: Extra Block Types: Image Gallery adds a reusable "EBT Image Gallery" block content type. Editors reference one or more Image media items through the standard Media Library widget and pick a predefined layout (1-5 columns, a fixed-size image grid, a fluid grid, or a featured-images grid); the images render in a CSS grid and open full size in a GLightbox lightbox, grouped as a single gallery. The block extends the shared ebt_core settings field, so it inherits the family's Design options (CSS box margins/padding/borders, background color and background media, container width, edge-to-edge). Being a block content type, a gallery can be placed in a region through Block layout, dropped into a Layout Builder section, or referenced from a field, which makes it reusable across many pages. Requires EBT Core, the GLightbox module and core Media, and an Image media type must already exist or installation fails on hook_requirements. Part of the wider EBT family (with a parallel EPT paragraph-type family). Maintained by Ivan Abramenko (levmyshkin) and Narine Tsaturyan.
